dialogue.intro:
You could get a camp sorted, or take some food and keep exploring.

If you're staying, start with a crafting table, somewhere to put your stuff, and a few torches. It doesn't need to be a whole base yet.

If you'd rather keep moving, find a forest and see what's around. You can figure out where to settle later.

Pick whichever you feel like doing first.

choices.label: Set up camp
choices.text: Alright, let's get a camp sorted. Start with a crafting table. You can deal with the rest as you need it.

choices.label: Keep exploring
choices.text: Fair enough. Grab some food and head out. Find a forest to get started.

dialogue.intro: The camp could use a few more supplies. Bring over 4 oak logs and 8 cobblestone when you've got them.
dialogue.progress: Send over what you have. You don't need to deliver it all at once.
dialogue.complete: That's enough for now. Grab your food and satchel. You can do another delivery in a bit.
dialogue.speaker: Field Notes

dialogue.intro: Bit of a warm-up before heading out. Accept this one and jump five times.
dialogue.progress: Five jumps. Only the ones after accepting count.
dialogue.complete: Alright, take the torches and get going.

dialogue.intro: First thing: a crafting table. Make one, or pick one up if you've already got one nearby.
dialogue.complete: There we go. Take your supplies, then pick a spot for the rest of your camp.
dialogue.speaker: Field Notes
dialogue.progress: Get a crafting table into your inventory, then claim your supplies.

dialogue.intro: Want to keep moving? Accept this one, then find a forest.
dialogue.complete: Found one. Grab what you need, then have a look around.
dialogue.speaker: Field Notes
dialogue.progress: Look for a regular forest biome. The other forest types won't count for this one.

dialogue.intro: Got a couple of spare sticks? Deliver two and take some food for the day.
dialogue.progress: Submit two sticks when you're ready. They'll come out of your inventory.
dialogue.complete: That's today's one done. Grab your food; you can do it again tomorrow.

dialogue.intro: The camp needs 8 cobblestone. Bring it together if you're in a party; on your own is fine too.
dialogue.progress: Everyone in the party can chip in. There's one set of rewards to share.
dialogue.complete: Stone delivered. One of you can claim the supplies, then split them however you like.

dialogue.intro: Bring 4 logs of any kind, plus an oak log named Camp Timber. Use an anvil to name that one.
dialogue.progress: The named oak log is a separate part of the delivery. Bring an extra log for it.
dialogue.complete: That's all of it. Grab your supplies.

dialogue.intro: Bring 4 sticks between you. Everyone in the party when you accept gets their own apple.
dialogue.complete: Delivery done. Make sure everyone grabs their share before starting another one.
dialogue.progress: You can all contribute to the same delivery. Everyone claims their own reward afterwards.

dialogue.intro: Got something to write home about? Pick a reply below. Locked replies show what you still need to do.
dialogue.complete: Got something to write home about? Pick a reply below.

choices.label: Write about the camp
choices.text: You've got a start on the camp. There's still plenty to build, but at least there's somewhere to leave your stuff.

choices.label: Write about the trip
choices.text: Found a forest and had a look around. Might stay a bit longer, or head back once your inventory's full.

dialogue.progress: Pick whichever reply fits what you've been up to.

dialogue.intro: Make or find a compass. It'll point you towards world spawn, which might help if you've wandered off.
dialogue.complete: Worth keeping on you. Just remember it points to world spawn, not your bed.
dialogue.progress: Get a compass into your inventory.
